mapper.select: SELECT rir.id, rir.daily_report_id, rir.report_item_definition_id, rir.checked, rir.created_at, rir.updated_at FROM report_item_responses rir LEFT JOIN report_item_definitions rid ON rid.id = rir.report_item_definition_id LEFT JOIN report_item_subtitles ris ON ris.id = rid.subtitle_id WHERE rir.daily_report_id = #{dailyReportId} ORDER BY ris.display_order ASC NULLS LAST, rid.display_order ASC NULLS LAST, rir.created_at ASC
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO report_item_responses (id, daily_report_id, report_item_definition_id, checked) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.dailyReportId}, #{item.reportItemDefinitionId}, #{item.checked})
